decisive_items: Figure 1. Title: Recurrent Melanoma Lesions on the Left Posterior Auricular Scalp Before and After T-VEC Therapy
Figure 2. Title: Histopathologic Findings of T-VEC–Treated Melanoma Lesions
Description: Shows complete tumor regression and neutrophil-rich mixed inflammation; MART-1 immunostain confirms complete tumor regression
response.rationale: The vignette explicitly references T-VEC therapy in the figure titles and describes histopathologic findings of T-VEC–treated melanoma with complete regression, making T-VEC–treated melanoma the most specific and supported diagnosis.

rejected.why: Recurrent melanoma is too broad and does not capture the specific T-VEC treatment context.
Melanoma is even broader and lacks the treatment-specific detail.
